title: frameit not shrinking text for multiline titles
body:
### New Issue Checklist - [x] Updated fastlane to the latest version - [x] I read the [Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) - [x] I read [docs.fastlane.tools](https://docs.fastlane.tools) - [x] I searched for [existing GitHub issues](https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues) ### Issue Description After an update to my app is re-ran my `create_screenshots` lane, which generated my screenshots and then ran `frameit`. However, the newly generated image do not seem to be reducing the size of the text of the title, causing the text to be clipped. I see this across multiple iOS devices and computers performing `frameit`. Below is an example from a 9.7" iPad, followed by the original screenshot. ![ipad pro 9 7-inch
